expiresAt.description: Optional TTL; absent means no TTL. The implementation that accepted the message at sendAgentMessage (the party that returned 202) MUST NOT deliver it after expiresAt; transports it hands the message to inherit the obligation. An expired undelivered run-correlated message is dropped and SHOULD be journaled as journal.message.expired (see the v4 journal envelope schema). (RFC 020)

runId.description: Run on whose behalf this message is sent; MUST be set when emitted in the context of a Run. (RFC 018)

correlationId.description: SHOULD match the correlation field of the corresponding appendEvent records, so journal queries reconstruct cross-agent causality. (RFC 018)
